Basic knowledge of financial modelling and forecasting techniques.
  
  
Ability to prepare MIS reports and management dashboards.
  
  
Familiarity with budgeting and variance analysis processes.
  
  
**Behavioural**
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
High attention to detail and accuracy.
  
  
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to work with large datasets and derive meaningful insights

title: US Mortgage
description:
**About us:**

Befree is a globally trusted provider of accounting and finance offshoring solutions. We blend

industry expertise with technology and automation to deliver customised, scalable support for

businesses worldwide.

Headquartered in Gandhinagar, with clients across Australia, the UK, the US, we help practices

and businesses enhance efficiency, productivity, and continuity through skilled and certified

professionals delivering world-class services. Our delivery centres across 10 cities in India

serve as the backbone of our global service delivery network.

**Role: US Mortgage Operations**

In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end processing support for Residential US

mortgage loans. You will work closely with brokers, lenders, and third-party vendors to

ensure timely, compliant, and accurate loan file processing through all stages of the

mortgage lifecycle.

**Responsibilities**

● Review and verify mortgage loan applications (1003 / URLA) and supporting

financial documents (W-2s, tax returns, pay stubs, bank statements, asset

documentation).

● Analyze Title Reports, Appraisals, Flood Certifications, Tax Transcripts (4506-C), VOE

(Verification of Employment), and Verification of Mortgage or Verification of Rent.

● Reconcile borrower income, assets, credit histories, and liabilities according to

Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, and USDA guidelines.

● Clear underwriting conditions and assist in resolving complex document

discrepancies or red flags.

● Ensure strict adherence to US mortgage regulatory compliance standards (TRID,

RESPA, TILA, CFPB, QM/ATR rules).

● Coordinate with settlement agents, title companies, and attorneys to gather closing

documents.

● Assist in post-closing reviews, trailing document management, and investor

delivery readiness.

● Maintain clear and direct communication with loan officers, processors, and

management regarding pipeline status and bottleneck resolution.

**Qualifications and Experience**

● Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Commerce,

or a related field.

● Exposure to NMLS guidelines, or coursework toward MBA-CMB or similar mortgage

banking certification.

● Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in US Residential Mortgage

Processing / Support. Prior experience working in a Global Capability Centre (GCC),

BPO, or shared services environment handling US mortgage operations.

● Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of the end-to-end US mortgage

lifecycle (Origination, Processing, Underwriting Support, Closing, Post-Closing).

● Guidelines: Solid knowledge of Conventional (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) and

Government (FHA / VA / USDA) loan products.

● Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with modern Loan Origination Systems

(LOS) such as Encompass, Calyx Point, or BytePro.

Key Skills

● Regulations: Familiarity with federal mortgage regulations including TRID, RESPA,

ECOA, and TILA.

● Skills: Ability to independently identify discrepancies across income, asset, and

credit documentation under production deadlines; clear written and verbal

communication with US-based stakeholders; strong numerical accuracy in

reconciling borrower financials.

This role goes beyond traditional bookkeeping. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring statutory compliance, managing receivables and payables, preparing financial reports, and supporting strategic business planning.

You will work directly with the founder, providing financial insights, supporting business projections, and contributing to investor-related financial documentation.

* Analyze sales performance, operating expenses, and profitability across business channels.
* Conduct variance analysis to identify financial trends and discrepancies.

6. Budgeting, Forecasting & Business Finance

* Prepare cash-flow forecasts and financial projections.
* Support product pricing, margin analysis, and unit economics calculations.
* Develop scenario-based financial models to evaluate business opportunities.

7. Investor Relations & Fundraising Support

* Exposure to financial modeling, budgeting, and business projections.

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager – Carrier & Freight Commercial**

**Role purpose**

This position owns the commercial relationship with every carrier the business uses — rate negotiation, lane allocation, contract renewal and freight cost assurance. It sits directly under the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics and is separate from trade and customs compliance, which is a distinct function. The role carries a monthly express freight spend running in the order of 23 crore, against which no contracted rate table currently exists for the India entities.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own every carrier contract end to end — FedEx across both India entities and the US entity, UPS, Emirates and new entrants — including a renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against every date, so that no term lapses unnoticed.

* Own lane allocation — routing volume to the right carrier by cost, transit time and service level — and document the logic so it can be audited and repeated.
* Govern dimensional divisors, fuel and surcharge concessions across all carriers, including the US amendment concessions that expire in February 2027 and revert to list.
* Own freight cost assurance — charged weight against company record, invoice audit before payment, and recovery claims through to credit.
* Drive down accessorial and exception charges by working with operations on root cause, not only by validating them after billing.
* Monitor volume commitments and surge clauses against contractual thresholds, and flag a breach before the carrier does.
* Run carrier governance — quarterly business reviews, SLA reviews, escalation matrices and service remedies.
* Report carrier cost monthly into the business review and into the gross margin programme.
* Support the trade and customs compliance function on carrier-side documentation, without owning compliance itself.

* 10 to 14 years in freight procurement, carrier management or logistics commercial, with direct hands-on negotiation with international express carriers.

* Deep working knowledge of express pricing mechanics — dimensional divisors, fuel tables, accessorial structures, zone and lane pricing, earned discount tiers and volume commitments.
* Freight audit and recovery experience, including building and defending a claim against a carrier.
* Strong commercial analytics — able to build a cost model, defend it to Finance, and put it in front of a carrier without it being picked apart.
* Exposure across air, ocean and parcel modes; export-led businesses preferred.
* Able to hold a senior carrier relationship and a difficult commercial conversation without damaging it.
* Graduate. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, or CIPS or equivalent procurement certification, an advantage.

* A complete rate card and contract baseline across every carrier, in one register.
* A renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against each date, including the February 2027 surcharge cliff.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
**About us:** 




 Befree is a globally trusted provider of accounting and finance offshoring solutions. We blend industry expertise with technology and automation to deliver customised, scalable support for businesses worldwide. Headquartered in Gandhinagar, with clients across Australia, the UK, the US, we help practices and businesses enhance efficiency, productivity, and continuity through skilled
 



 and certified professionals delivering world\-class services. Our delivery centres across 10 cities in India serve as the backbone of our global service delivery network.
 



  





**Role: Internal Audit** 




 We are seeking an experienced Assistant Manager – Internal Audit to lead a two\-member
 



 internal audit team within our service organization. The incumbent will be responsible for
 



 building and executing a robust audit framework, driving process improvements, and
 



 ensuring end\-to\-end compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. This
 



 role requires hands\-on leadership, strong knowledge of Indian taxation and GST, and the
 



 ability to translate audit findings into actionable business improvements.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Team Leadership \& Audit Management** 




 ● Lead, supervise, and review the daily work of a two\-member internal audit team.
 



 ● Assign audit engagements, set timelines, and ensure quality of deliverables.
 



 ● Mentor team members and support their professional development.
 



 ● Report audit status and findings to senior management / CFO on a regular basis
 



  





**Process Audit** 




 ● Plan and conduct end\-to\-end process audits across all service delivery and support functions.
 



 ● Map existing processes, identify deviations from defined workflows, and highlight inefficiencies.
 



 ● Recommend process re\-engineering measures and verify implementation of agreed changes.
 



  





**SOP Implementation \& Review** 




 ● Develop, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments.
 



 ● Verify adherence to SOPs through periodic walkthroughs and surprise audits.
 



 ● Work with department heads to close gaps between documented procedures and actual practices
 



  





**Risk Assessment** 




 ● Prepare and maintain a risk register covering financial, operational, compliance,
 



 and reputational risks.
 



 ● Conduct risk\-based audit planning — prioritizing high\-risk areas for deeper
 



 scrutiny.
 



 ● Present risk assessment results and mitigation plans to leadership quarterly.
 



  





**Internal Controls** 




 ● Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls across all functions.
 



 ● Identify control weaknesses and work with process owners to design and implement stronger controls.
 



 ● Follow up on all audit action points to ensure timely remediation.
 



  





**Compliance – Indian Taxation \& GST** 




 ● Ensure adherence to all applicable Indian taxation laws including Income Tax (TDS, advance tax, etc.).
 



 ● Monitor GST compliance — return filings (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9\), reconciliations, and ITC claims.
 



 ● Review vendor and client contracts for tax implications and flag non\-compliances proactively.
 



 ● Stay updated on changes in GST, Income Tax, and other relevant laws applicable to the service sector.
 



  





**Audit Documentation \& Reporting** 




 ● Maintain comprehensive audit working papers, evidence files, and documentation in line with best practices.
 



 ● Prepare clear, concise internal audit reports with findings, root cause analysis, risk ratings, and recommendations.
 



 ● Maintain an audit tracker to monitor status of all open and closed observations.
 



 ● Ensure audit documentation is audit\-ready for external auditors, management, or regulatory reviews at all times.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* CA Inter / CA Final / CMA / MBA (Finance) – preferred.
* B.Com / M.Com graduates with strong relevant experience will also be considered Experience
* 3 to 4 years of experience in Internal Audit, Finance \& Accounts, or related fields.
* Prior experience in a service industry organization is strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading audit teams and managing multiple concurrent
* audit assignments.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Solid understanding of Process Audits, SOP drafting, Risk Assessment, and Internal Controls.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Indian Taxation – TDS, Income Tax Act, and related compliances.
* Strong working knowledge of GST – GSTR filings, ITC reconciliation, and e\-invoicing.
* Proficient in Tally ERP 9, SAP FICO, or similar accounting/ERP systems.
* Advanced MS Excel skills for data analysis, audit sampling, and MIS preparation
